concept.title: 『Moya』
concept.description:
Through the formless 'moya' (mist/haze), we move forward.
The other side, visible yet out of reach.
Lost, pausing, sometimes losing sight,
but by continuing to walk, light gradually appears.
Such a path clears the 'moya'.
